source.author: lucan
source.text: Atque aliquis, magno quaerens exempla timori, Non alios, inquit, motus tunc fata parabant, Cum post Teutonicos victor Libycosque triumphos Exsul limosa Marius caput abdidit ulva.
source.text_original: Atque aliquis, magno quaerens exempla timori, / Non alios, inquit, motus tunc fata parabant, / Cum post Teutonicos victor Libycosque triumphos / Exsul limosa Marius caput abdidit ulva.
source.text_english: And someone, seeking examples for his great fear, said: then fate was not preparing any other movements, when after the Teutonic and Libyan triumphs, the victor Marius, an exile, hid his head in the muddy sedge.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_original: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, / Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_english: But if Fortune is preparing something else, have pity on my parents, gentle Death, while there is still fear and not yet pain.
